def check(x,y):
    cnt = 0
    while x>0:
        tmp = x%10
        if tmp==y:
            cnt+=1
        x=int(x/10)
    return cnt
n = int(input())
k = int(input())

for i in range(1,n+1):
    ans += check(i,k)
